goals: Verify that an NGO can successfully register in the system
Verify that an NGO can successfully log into the system
activities: Enter the name into the name field
Enter the email into the email field
Enter the WhatsApp number into the whatsapp field
Enter the city into the city field
Enter the state (UF) into the uf field
Intercept the POST request to the ongs endpoint
Wait for the intercepted POST request to complete
Verify that the response status is 200
Verify that the response body has an 'id' property
Verify that the response 'id' is not null
Enter the created ONG ID into the input field
